TITLE: Student residence permit for university or higher professional education | IND

Student residence permit for university or higher professional education
Last update: 21 September 2026
You want a residence permit to study in the Netherlands at a university or institute of higher professional education (in Dutch:
hoger beroepsonderwijs or HBO
). Only this educational institution can apply for a residence permit for you. Find out what the requirements are and how your educational institution can apply for a student residence permit.
